name: Kota`s New Journey
source:
An elven sorceress decides to visit her old friend, but gets caught up in a series of exciting (and slightly lewd) adventures, where she finds new friends, rare spells... and loses her swimsuit.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270680]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一位精灵女术士决定拜访她的老朋友，但却陷入了一系列令人兴奋（并且有点淫荡）的冒险，在那里她找到了新朋友，稀有咒语……并失去了她的泳衣。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270680]Steam[/url]]
